KeepActive Setup & Architecture Guide

Browser-only setup, shortcuts, and operational limits, plus the optional native helper

Quick Start Procedure

01

Load the Package

Install KeepActive from the Chrome Web Store.Install the full build from its package folder. For development, go to chrome://extensions, enable Developer mode, click Load unpacked, and select the packaged folder. This build runs entirely inside Chrome.This build runs inside Chrome and can optionally connect to a separately installed local helper.

02

Configure Operational Engines

Click the KeepActive toolbar icon to open the Master Deck. Toggle the master switch and choose your operating engines:

  • Display Keep-Awake: Uses Chrome's Power API while Chrome is running. Enterprise lock policy can still lock the device.
  • Teams Web Activity: Sends periodic pointer movement and occasional harmless Shift pulses to top-level Microsoft Teams Web tabs. It never clicks or types text.
03

Schedule Automated Shifts & Smart Pause

Open the Control Deck (Settings) to configure your shift hours (e.g. 09:30 to 18:30). KeepActive automatically engages when your shift starts and releases when it ends. Smart Pause uses the operating system idle signal: it pauses while you are active and resumes only after your configured away period.

04

Optional: Native Desktop Helper (Full Build)

The full package adds an optional local helper for Microsoft Teams Desktop. While the system reports you idle, it nudges the real pointer by 2-3 pixels and restores it. It never clicks, types text, or runs while you are active.

  • Windows: native\install.ps1 -ExtensionId <extension-id>
  • macOS/Linux: native/install.sh --extension-id <extension-id>
  • Requires Python 3.8+. On macOS, grant Accessibility permission. Reload the extension after installing.
  • Teams Desktop presence is controlled by Microsoft and is not guaranteed.

Enterprise Environment Notice

  • Centralized corporate IT endpoint policies (InTune, Group Policy, MDM) can enforce screen lock regardless of browser state.
  • KeepActive does not defeat, conceal, or modify corporate telemetry from endpoint detection software (EDR).
  • Always confirm compliance with your organization's internal acceptable use guidelines.

Browser-Only Build

Install Scope
No installer

Runs entirely inside Chrome. No native app, Python runtime, registry entry, or additional download.

Extension Permissions
Browser APIs only

Display keep-awake, Teams Web activity, schedule, Smart Pause, and diagnostics. No nativeMessaging permission.

Two Build Variants

Store Build
Browser-only

Display keep-awake, Teams Web activity, schedule, Smart Pause, diagnostics. No nativeMessaging permission and no installer. Intended for Chrome Web Store distribution.

Full Build
Browser + desktop helper

Everything in the store build plus optional nativeMessaging. Intended for local/developer installation where Teams Desktop support is needed. Keep the extension ID stable after installing the helper.
